name: Sales Below Cost Analysis Report
query:
SELECT 
    si.name AS "Invoice No",
    DATE(si.posting_date) AS "Date",
    si.customer_name AS "Customer",
    sii.item_code AS "Item",
    sii.item_group AS "Item Group",
    ROUND(sii.qty, 0) AS "Quantity",
    ROUND(sii.rate, 2) AS "Selling Rate",
    ROUND(sle.valuation_rate, 2) AS "Avg. Cost",
    ROUND(ABS(sii.base_amount - (sle.valuation_rate * sii.stock_qty)), 2) AS "Loss Amount",
    ROUND(((sle.valuation_rate * sii.stock_qty) - sii.base_amount) / sii.base_amount * 100, 2) AS "Percent Loss"
FROM 
    `tabSales Invoice` si
INNER JOIN 
    `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON si.name = sii.parent INNER JOIN 
    `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle 
        ON sle.voucher_no = si.name 
        AND sle.voucher_type = "Sales Invoice"
        AND sle.item_code = sii.item_code WHERE 
    si.docstatus = 1 
    AND si.status != "Cancelled"
    AND si.is_return = 0
    AND sle.valuation_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND sle.valuation_rate > 0
    AND sii.rate < sle.valuation_rate
    AND si.posting_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND CURDATE() ORDER BY 
    ((sle.valuation_rate * sii.stock_qty) - sii.base_amount) / sii.base_amount * 100 DESC,
    si.posting_date DESC;
